item.description: Broken, not dead: Agathides #3356 the Twice-Born (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Chalybes forges). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Hermnikos #7333 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scatt
item.description: Hermnikos #7333 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Hermnikos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: A child for the Gegeneis: Kallshles Ariphonides ~2520, born to Ariphon #5302 and Eurides Phaidides ~196. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.title: Hermnikos #7333 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Chthonius
item.description: Hermnikos #7333 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Chthonius made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Hermnikos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
